sql: SELECT T2.skill, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.posting_key) AS listings_mentioning FROM fct_posting AS T1 INNER JOIN posting_skills AS T2 ON T1.posting_key = T2.posting_key WHERE T1.is_open = TRUE AND T1.remote_us = TRUE GROUP BY T2.skill ORDER BY listings_mentioning DESC LIMIT 10
